curation_description: Curated benchmark reference database composed of 45 authoritative geographic entities (Admin-0 countries, Admin-1 states/provinces, major global enterprise cities, and controlled disambiguation fixtures including Springfield, Washington, Cambridge) with 144 verified alias mappings and 24 international dialing prefixes. Each entry was individually extracted, cross-verified against official upstream datasets, normalized to Unicode NFC, and checked for topological hierarchy consistency.

sources.license: Public Domain / CC0 (Free for commercial and non-commercial use)
sources.transformation_performed: Extracted ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 and alpha-3 codes, sovereign canonical names, display names, and approximate sovereign centroid coordinates for primary benchmark nations (IN, US, GB, FR, DE, AU, SG, JP, etc.). Centroids formatted to 4 decimal places.
sources.attribution_requirement: None legally required by CC0; credited for academic and open-source traceability.
sources.runtime_dependency: NONE (Pre-indexed static JSON snapshot; zero network calls)
sources.update_procedure: Annual review against Natural Earth vector releases; verification of ISO code stability.

sources.transformation_performed: Extracted canonical city coordinates (designated CITY_REFERENCE_POINT), official IANA timezones (e.g. Asia/Kolkata, America/Chicago, Europe/London), Admin-1 subdivision codes, and historical/common city aliases (e.g., Bangalore -> Bengaluru, Bombay -> Mumbai, Calcutta -> Kolkata, airport aliases BLR/BOM/LON/TYO/SYD). Also extracted multi-state test disambiguation targets (Springfield IL/MO/MA/OH, Cambridge ENG/MA, Washington DC/WA).

sources.update_procedure: Quarterly extraction of high-population urban centers and validated aliases via GeoNames dumps.
